command:
set -eu
git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin refs/heads/main
SHA=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
printf 'MAIN=%s\n' "$SHA"
printf '%s\n' '--- PATHS ---'
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$SHA" | grep -Ei '(alignment|sandbox|effect.*interlock|interlock.*effect|local_bridge|voice_action_guard|authority.*contract|executor)' | head -n 220 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- CONTENT MATCHES ---'
git grep -n -Ei 'bubblewrap|\bbwrap\b|landlock|seccomp|host[-_ ]side effect|effect sandbox|delete.*denied|format.*denied|execution_boundary|cap_sys_admin|unshare' "$SHA" -- ':!dump*' ':!free swarm*' ':!research_sources*' | head -n 260 || true
